brand_dna.category: Locally-rooted apparel and gift shop selling Camas hometown, school spirit, and Pacific Northwest gear.
brand_dna.core_belief: Papermaker Pride was born from combining a love of sports, a drive for high quality apparel, and relentless support of their hometown - giving back to the community that supports them while instilling pride in where they call home.
proof_points: Physical store located in the heart of downtown Camas at 339 NE 4th Ave, Camas, WA

brand_dna.positioning: Community-first local pride brand - quality-focused and hometown-authentic rather than mass-market or generic.

banned.why: FTC substantiation - unqualified superlative that cannot be objectively proven; soften to a subjective preference framing.

banned.claim: The best local gear / best quality apparel stated as fact
banned.why: FTC - unqualified superlatives; only usable as attributed customer opinion, not brand claim.

banned.claim: Invented review counts or star ratings
banned.why: FTC - no reviews were found on site; fabricating counts or endorsements is prohibited.

banned.claim: Guaranteed to retain shape forever or never shrink
banned.why: FTC - guaranteed results; testimonial about shape retention reflects one customer, not a promised typical outcome.

banned.claim: Fake urgency such as 'only hours left' when stock is standing
banned.why: FTC - deceptive fake urgency not supported by actual inventory or timers.
